Protein coordinate fixtures downloaded from RCSB PDB on 2026-10-03:

- [1CRN](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1CRN), crambin: `https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CRN.pdb` and `.cif`. Tests compare both formats, 46 residues and three recorded disulfides.
- [1UBQ](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1UBQ), ubiquitin: `https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UBQ.pdb`. Tests cover 76 amino acids, waters and nitrogen hydrogen completion.

These are experimental coordinate fixtures, not Beavyr optimization results.
